import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
ARRAY_SIZE = 10000

def task_func():
    # Generate random integers between 1 and 100 inclusive
    arr = np.random.randint(1, 101, size=ARRAY_SIZE)

    # Compute statistics
    mean_val = float(np.mean(arr))
    std_val = float(np.std(arr))

    # Create histogram
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
    ax.hist(arr, bins=np.arange(1, 102) - 0.5, color="skyblue", edgecolor="black")

    # Plot mean as a red dashed line
    ax.axvline(mean_val, color="red", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label=f"Mean: {mean_val:.2f}")

    # Plot standard deviation as purple dashed lines at mean ± std
    ax.axvline(mean_val - std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label=f"Mean - Std: {mean_val - std_val:.2f}")
    ax.axvline(mean_val + std_val, color="purple", linestyle="--", linewidth=2, label=f"Mean + Std: {mean_val + std_val:.2f}")

    # Labels and title
    ax.set_title("Histogram of Random Integers")
    ax.set_xlabel("Value")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.legend()

    return arr, mean_val, std_val, ax
